name: Alejandro Vargas
bio:
Alejandro's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental, born from a family catering business in Bogotá that occasionally served local racing teams. He quickly realized the unique demands of feeding a hungry, high-pressure team in the fast-paced world of racing. He joined Lechner Racing five years ago, after proving his skills managing catering for smaller teams across South America.

Alejandro's approach centers on providing healthy, energizing meals that accommodate diverse dietary needs and preferences. He's a stickler for quality ingredients and maintaining the highest standards of hygiene, essential in the confined spaces of the paddock kitchen. He's known for his ability to adapt to last-minute changes and his calm demeanor, even when faced with unexpected requests or logistical challenges. What sets Alejandro apart is his use of traditional Colombian flavors to create unique and comforting dishes for the team, helping them feel at home no matter where they are racing.

He aims to always keep everyone in top physical condition by delivering the best food possible. He firmly believes that a well-fed team is a winning team. He is very popular among the engineers and drivers.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Alejandro has a warm, friendly face and a stocky build from years of lifting heavy catering equipment.

quirks: Insists on playing traditional Colombian music while preparing meals.
Always has a stash of arepas on hand for anyone feeling homesick.
Meticulously labels and organizes every container in the pantry.
